name: The Jesus Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Catholic church of the Most Holy Name of Jesus stands at the west end of the town, near the old road to the river.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Oundle's churches and chapels show how many different groups of worshippers the town has had over the centuries.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:A carter resting here says Martha Pell's horses were stabled at the edge of town all night, a long way from the Talbot. (Long walk only.)]]

evidence: [[c:Martha's horses and cart were stabled at the edge of town all night.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 40 metres as the crow flies, to Oundle Museum.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
